subject: Medivent billing cadence and temporary credit buffer request
messages:
From: Sophia Leone <sophia.leone@medivent.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, accounts-payable@medivent.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Net60 & temporary credit increase for Q3 usage

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're doing well. We're seeing materially higher usage than originally forecast for July due to a new rollout across three hospitals. Our procurement team is working on a PO but asked whether Redwood can temporarily extend Net60 terms and raise our credit cap from $50k to $150k for the next 90 days. They also asked about how VAT will be reflected — we operate out of the US but will need invoices with VAT breakdown for our EU subsidiaries.

Attached is June's invoice and our draft PO (Medivent_PO_7890.pdf). Can your team confirm: 
- Whether Net60 can be granted for Q3 only (July–September)
- If a one-time credit buffer is possible while PO is finalized
- How Redwood will issue VAT-inclusive or VAT-breakdown invoices for cross-border teams

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Sophia Leone
Director, Finance Operations
Medivent Health
(sophia.leone@medivent.com)

Attachments: Medivent_Invoice_Jun2026.pdf (pdf), Medivent_PO_7890.pdf (pdf)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sophia Leone <sophia.leone@medivent.com>, accounts-payable@medivent.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & temporary credit increase for Q3 usage

Hi Sophia — great to hear the rollout is going well. Thanks for the invoice and PO in advance. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We can consider a temporary extension to Net60 for Q3, but will need an updated PO and a simple credit application signed by Medivent finance (I attached our form).
- For the credit buffer: we typically approve a short-term buffer up to 2x your current committed spend after a quick credit review. That would be conditional on: PO confirmation, a signed credit form, and a weekend run-rate check.
- VAT: Redwood issues invoices with VAT lines where applicable. For US shipments we don't apply EU VAT, but we can provide VAT breakdowns and a separate invoice template for your EU subsidiaries (we'll need the EU VAT IDs).

I've looped in Markus (FP&A) for the credit-side and Grace (CS) to brief on the rollout/activation so invoices align with usage.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the signed PO and EU VAT IDs by EOD Wed (June 30).
2) We run a credit review (Markus) and confirm a temporary buffer by Thu.
3) If green, Redwood will issue a revised invoice schedule and a DocuSign for the credit form.

If any of those dates are tight, tell me and we can adjust.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_credit_application_form.pdf (pdf)

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, Sophia Leone <sophia.leone@medivent.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & temporary credit increase for Q3 usage

Hi all,

Quick update from finance after a preliminary review of the June invoice and the historic payment pattern we have on file. Two things:

1) We can approve a time-limited credit buffer up to $120,000 (≈2.4x current $50k cap) for a 60–90 day window provided: 
   - Medivent signs the credit application (attached)
   - PO is submitted and references Redwood deal RDW-9873
   - First invoice under the new cadence is paid within 60 days of issuance

2) Net60 across the board is acceptable for the Q3 window if the PO and EU VAT IDs are provided. We'll issue invoices net of VAT where appropriate and provide a separate VAT breakdown file for your EU entities.

I'll prepare the conditional approval memo; Vanessa, could you confirm the proposed billing cadence (monthly invoice on 1st of month) so I can reference it?

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of FP&A
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_credit_application_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Sophia Leone <sophia.leone@medivent.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@medivent.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & temporary credit increase for Q3 usage

Thanks Vanessa and Markus — appreciate the quick turnaround. We're comfortable with the conditional structure. Per your request: 
- PO 7890 has been reissued with Redwood deal ID RDW-9873 and attached as Medivent_PO_7890.pdf.
- EU VAT IDs: Medivent EU Ops (BE): BE0123456789; Medivent EU Ops (DE): DE987654321
- We'll sign the credit application today and return via DocuSign.

Couple of asks from our procurement team: 
- Can Redwood confirm the invoice delivery method: email + SFTP for bulk statements?
- For the first Net60 invoice, please include a short description line to map charges to the rollout ("Q3 hospital rollout — production tokens").

Grace — can you share the internal rollout schedule so SAP/finance gets the mapping they need?

Best,
Sophia

Attachments: Medivent_PO_7890.pdf (pdf)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sophia Leone <sophia.leone@medivent.com>, accounts-payable@medivent.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 14:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 & temporary credit increase for Q3 usage

Perfect — thanks for the quick action, Sophia. Final confirmations: 

- Redwood will ship monthly invoices on the 1st of each month for the Q3 window (July/Aug/Sep) with Net60 payment terms.
- Conditional credit buffer approved at $120,000 for 90 days starting from the first revised invoice date. This is contingent on the signed credit application and receipt of PO (we've received the PO).
- VAT: we'll send US invoices net of VAT and create separate VAT breakout files for BE and DE using the IDs you provided.
- Delivery: invoices will be emailed to accounts-payable@medivent.com and SFTP access will be provisioned; Grace will coordinate the statement format.

Action items: 
- Sophia: complete DocuSign for the credit form (link sent via separate DocuSign email).
- Markus: I'll need the conditional approval memo and the updated billing schedule PDF for the Medivent AP mailbox.
- Grace: please share the rollout mapping by EOD Mon so the invoice descriptions match SAP coding.

Once the DocuSign is complete we'll push the revised invoice schedule and confirm the buffer. Appreciate the collaboration here — I'll keep this thread for records.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
